title: Evidence is not acceptance
summary: Translation success, tests, Gopher rule passes, package checks, semantic scans and impact reports are evidence for an acceptance decision. None self-author acceptance. The default LLM/developer/operator role must not receive source.semantic.accept or source.semantic.proposal.decide.
invariants: Missing evidence remains unknown/review-required, never implicit allow.
Acceptance requires explicit authority plus exact component, lineage, parent level and candidate digest fencing.
External-operation tracking proposals are reviewed decisions, not analyzer guesses promoted to history.
